summary.text: Hanadi Nadeem is a Democratic member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 34 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hanadi Nadeem's career experience includes overseeing a healthcare business, and she has served as president of APPNA Alliance.
She assumed office on November 6, 2024, succeeding Shannon Bilbray-Axelrod, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Health and Human Services, Judiciary, and Legislative Operations and Elections committees.
Her Republican opponent in the 2026 general election is Brandon Davis.
